bootstrap.design: within each of 12 strata resample 256 entities with replacement; indices shared across lifts, models and scenarios; PCG64(seed base+7); percentile 2.5/97.5, linear

calibration.global_c: per-lift c = clip(sqrt(mean_CAL_C(r^2/sigma_raw^2)),0.25,4); sigma_C = clip(c*sigma_raw,0.25,100)  [arms M0_C, M1_C, M2_C]
calibration.group_G: per lift x plan x horizon g = clip(sqrt((n*R+kappa)/(n+kappa)),0.70,1.40), R=mean_CAL_G(r^2/sigma_C^2), n=group rows (256), kappa=256; sigma_G = clip(g*sigma_C,0.25,100)  [arms M1_G, M2_G; the contender for the temporal model is M2_G vs M2_C]
calibration.sigma_raw: per lift x plan x horizon RMS of DEV residuals, clipped to [0.25,100] kg (all three models)

disposition_rules.BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_RIGHTS_OR_RESOURCE: a ceiling, rights check or technical failure prevented completion; no budget extension
disposition_rules.OBSERVABLE_FORECASTING_NOT_QUALIFIED: M2_C macro CRPS not below M1_C on both control parents, OR M2_C not below M0_C on both control parents
disposition_rules.OBSERVABLE_FORECASTING_QUALIFIED_WITHIN_: primary superiority screen met on both parents AND M2_C macro CRPS below M0_C on both control parents AND pooled M2_C 90% coverage within [85,95]% on both control parents AND no nonfinite predictions

endpoints.multiplicity: primary is the only confirmatory inference; everything else is descriptive with unadjusted intervals and overlapping, non-independent metrics
endpoints.primary: paired macro CRPS difference M2_C - M1_C on CONTROL, each TEST parent; absolute, relative %, 95% percentile entity-cluster bootstrap interval
secondary_descriptive: lift x plan x horizon calibration
endpoints.superiority_screen: relative improvement >= 1% on EACH parent and interval upper bound < 0 on EACH parent (exploratory criterion, not a clinical meaningful change)

firewall.feature_permissions: RES-615 visible-feature builder (history summaries, schedule, plan numerics, plan indicators) plus plan/horizon one-hots; entity ids, C, E, parameters and future draws are never inputs
firewall.future_noise: separate random.Random stream per role (seed base+5), consumed only when the target is generated; paired scenarios reuse the same stream
firewall.strength: in-process organizational barrier recorded by hashes; not adversarial
truth_order: generate FIT, DEV, CAL_C, CAL_G; fit M1 (alpha on DEV), M2 (FIT, DEV early stop)
fit sigma tables on DEV, c on CAL_C, G on CAL_G; freeze and hash all parameters
generate TEST_A/TEST_B scenarios; compute and hash all predictions (seal)
open TEST truth once; score; no refitting or rescoring

models.M0: persistence: latest admissible assessment (day 223) for the lift

M1.alpha_selection: DEV only: lowest mean over lifts of DEV RMSE
M1.features: 127 RES-615 visible summaries + 12 plan/horizon one-hots + 12 one-hots x that lift's last assessment and assessment slope (24) = 163, FIT-standardized
M1.penalty: minimize mean squared error + alpha*||beta||^2, unpenalized intercept
M1.target: Y minus latest assessment, per lift

M2.early_stopping: DEV standardized MSE, patience 4, min improvement 1e-4, best state kept
M2.family: GRU (LiftSharedTemporalExpert, unchanged architecture, new random init)
M2.note: historical latent-capacity GRU outputs are NOT used as observable predictors
M2.optimizer: AdamW lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, betas (0.9,0.999), batch 256, gradient clip 1.0, constant lr, dropout as in architecture
M2.target: Y minus latest assessment, FIT-standardized per lift; prediction = last + delta

nonclaims: synthetic assessment measurements, not competition 1RM records
no real-athlete validity, physiological identification or causal prescription
training-seed stability NOT TESTED (one fitted GRU)
no robustness claim beyond two named within-support shifts
pooled calibration is not subgroup calibration; statistical is not practical significance

resources.after_test_truth_opened: preserve records and stop on failure; never adjust and rescore

protocol.reused_from_res615: scoring mathematics (Gaussian CRPS/NLL, intervals), visible-feature builder, group-factor and scale formulas, array/CSV helpers, rights-checked released assets

rights.fail_closed: non-empty output directory, nonfinite values or a breached ceiling stop the run
rights.historical_checkpoints: not loaded or used; the RES-274 latent-capacity GRU is not an observable predictor
rights.inputs: MIT project code and the public synthetic generator only; new seeds; no athlete data, no private RES-576/577 bytes, no historical H/H_GT/G parameters
rights.outputs: aggregate tables, figures and manifests are project-generated (MIT); cohort rows and fitted GRU weights are not committed (weights identified by SHA-256)

roles.generation: GenerationConfig(train_rows=N, validation_rows=12); keep the N train rows
roles.strata_balance: 256 entities per plan/horizon stratum in each 3072-row cohort
roles.test_parents: exactly two independent parents; no replacement after results

shifts.ADAPTATION_TIMESCALE_SHIFT: population coordinates 4, 8, 12 u -> sqrt(u) before the original parameter mapping; histories and Y regenerated with the same seeds and noise streams; equations unchanged
shifts.VELOCITY_NOISE_SHIFT: add independent Normal(0, source lift velocity SD) to every history velocity only; seed base+6; targets byte-identical to CONTROL
shifts.claim: two named within-support mechanisms; 2 parents x 3 scenarios = 6 dependent scenario sets, not six populations; no claim of robustness to arbitrary shifts

target.cessation_rule: NO truncation. Cessation lowers capacity C but expressed performance E may rise as suppression dissipates, so Y<=0-type support rules from RES-615 are forbidden (check_target_compatibility rejects the latent kind and never truncates)
target.negative_mass: report P(Y<0) under each Gaussian; introduce no support transformation

semantics.definition: Y = E[t]*(1+Normal(0,cv_lift)) at t=origin+horizon-1 via the simulator's declared assessment law; E is expressed performance, C is latent capacity (both hidden)
semantics.not: real competition 1RM; latent capacity; expressed performance
semantics.quantity: future noisy standardized synthetic strength assessment Y

task.information: histories through day 223, schedule through day 223, declared plan, horizon; no latent state, parameter, entity id, or future observation
